info.name: Quiz Exam App API (Faculty + Student)
info.description: Trimmed-down REST API collection for a standalone examination app: faculty login + their quiz list, and the complete student exam flow (list allotted quizzes, geofence check, start attempt, fetch questions, save answers, submit, view published results). Set `baseUrl` to your running server. Login requests auto-save accessToken/refreshToken; Start Attempt auto-saves attemptId - run requests top to bottom inside a folder and you shouldn't need to copy anything by hand.

request.description: `identifier` can be the faculty's roll number, email, or mobile number - not just email.
`identifier` can be the student's roll number, email, or mobile number - not just email.

identifier is roll number, email, or mobile - works for both a student and a faculty account. Always returns the same generic success message regardless of whether the account exists, so the response never reveals which identifiers are real. If it does exist, a 5-digit OTP is sent via the RGIPT ERP API - by email always, and also by SMS to the account's registered mobile number if it's a valid 10-digit number. Both channels are independent best-effort sends; expires in 10 minutes.
otp is the 5-digit code from Forgot Password. Fails with 400 "Invalid or expired code" if wrong, expired, already used, or after 5 wrong attempts on the same code.

Goes live: flips status from draft/scheduled to live and stamps actualStartTime. Also callable by an admin as an override. 400 if the quiz is already live, 400 if completed (cannot restart), 400 if it has no questions yet, 400 if no students are allotted yet. Only works for a quiz owned by this faculty (404 otherwise) unless called by an admin. Once live, students with an allotment can call Start Attempt below.

Ends a live quiz: flips status to completed, auto-submits (and scores) every attempt still in_progress using its currently saved answers, then marks every still-"allotted" student absent. 400 if the quiz isn't currently "live" (already completed, or not started yet) - only a live quiz can be stopped. Only works for a quiz owned by this faculty (404 otherwise). Do this BEFORE Publish Result - publishing requires status completed.

Single-step result publish - there is no separate "declare" step, so the app and portal must both call this the same action and label it the same way ("Publish Result", not "Declare Result"). Computes each attempt's total from its already-scored answers (including any negative marking) and writes every submitted/auto_submitted attempt's Result straight to status "published", visible to the student immediately. Preconditions - each returns a 400 with a specific message if not met: (1) quiz.status must be "completed" (call Stop Quiz first), (2) every subjective answer in the quiz must already be manually graded, (3) at least one attempt must be submitted/auto_submitted. 404 if this faculty doesn't own the quiz. Idempotent - safe to call again (e.g. after grading more subjective answers or new students submit).

Flips a student's submitted or auto_submitted attempt back to in_progress so they can resume - saved answers are untouched. 400 if the attempt is already in_progress, 400 if the quiz has been stopped (status completed), 404 if there's no attempt at all. Also resets the allotment status back to "allotted". Only works for a quiz owned by this faculty.

Checks the logged-in faculty's current location against the quiz's building radius - same check the student flow uses, but for the faculty invigilating that quiz. Only works for a quiz owned by this faculty (404 otherwise). Returns isWithinRange, distanceMeters, allowedRadiusMeters, buildingName. If the quiz has requireLocation=false, returns isWithinRange: true with skipped: true instead of failing.
Flags someone else appearing to take the exam as that student - a proxy always counts as absent regardless of what's been submitted. Only works for a quiz owned by this faculty.
Reverts a proxy flag, restoring the student's real status: "attempted" if they have a submitted attempt, otherwise back to "allotted".
Exempts this one student from the quiz's GPS/location requirement - they can start the attempt from anywhere, regardless of Quiz.requireLocation.
Reinstates the location requirement for this student.
Quizzes allotted to the logged-in student. Copy an `id` from a quiz with status "live" into the `quizId` collection variable before starting the exam flow below.
Lets the app warn the student before they commit to starting - the server re-checks location again on Start Attempt regardless.

Fails with 403 if outside the quiz building's geofence radius, 400 if the quiz isn't live, 409 if already attempted. On success, returns attemptId, durationMinutes and totalQuestions - start a countdown timer client-side from durationMinutes.

Returns questions in the randomized/fixed order fixed at Start Attempt, with MCQ options but never the correct answer or reference answer. Also returns myAnswer if this question was already saved (so a resumed/refreshed exam restores state).
Call once per answer/change - it upserts, so re-sending the same questionId overwrites the previous choice. Works while the attempt is in_progress only.
Subjective answers are never auto-scored - marksObtained stays 0 until a faculty member grades it after submission.

Scores every MCQ/numeric answer immediately (marksObtained, isCorrect) and returns the total - but the Result row is created with status "pending" and is NOT visible to the student yet. It only appears under My Results once the faculty calls Publish Result on their side (single step - there is no separate declare step). For an auto-submit (timer ran out / stopped by faculty), send {"autoSubmitted": true, "reason": "time_up"}.
Only ever returns results with status "published". Summary only (marksObtained/percentage per quiz) - use Get Attempt Result Detail below for the per-question breakdown.

Per-question breakdown for a submitted attempt: your answer, whether it was correct, the correct option(s)/value, and marks obtained. Returns 403 until the faculty has run Publish Result for this quiz. Subjective questions show manuallyGraded: false and marksObtained: 0 until a faculty member grades them.
